title: Sweet & Sour Sauce – Home Chef Flex
description: Tangy, sweet, and versatile—adjust sweetness, tang, or add heat. Perfect for home cooking and fridge-friendly storage.

method.instruction: In a small saucepan, combine ketchup, brown sugar, white vinegar, pineapple juice (if using), and soy sauce.
Place over medium heat and stir until the sugar dissolves completely.
Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally.
If you want a thicker sauce, stir the cornflour mixture to ensure it's smooth, then add it to the simmering sauce.
Cook for another 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly, until the sauce thickens to your desired consistency.
Remove from heat and use immediately, or let cool and store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 1 week.

notes.title: Balance the Flavors
notes.content: Taste and adjust: add more vinegar for tang, more sugar for sweetness, or a splash of soy sauce for depth.

notes.title: Add Heat
notes.content: Stir in 1/2-1 tsp of chili flakes or a dash of sriracha for a spicy kick.

notes.title: Uses
notes.content: Perfect for sweet and sour pork, chicken stir-fries, spring rolls, or as a dipping sauce for fried appetizers.

notes.title: Home Chef Flex
notes.content: Versatile, adjustable, and fridge-friendly—ideal for home cooking with options to tweak sweetness, tang, or spice.
